notes.title: Game is reactivated!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that we will continue developing games under the Woodcrest Games label. As a result, we're now able to reactivate Escape: The Brother's Saloon in the Steam store! To celebrate, starting tomorrow, April 29, the game will be 50% off for the next couple weeks.

But that's not all! We've been working hard on a new Escape game, and we're happy to announce that the store page for our next game, Escape: The Research Center is now live! Check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3463750/Escape_The_Research_Center/

notes.title: Removing Escape: The Brother's Saloon from the Steam store
notes.notes:
First and foremost, we want to extend our deepest gratitude to every single player who has supported Escape: The Brother's Saloon. Our company is undergoing a reorganization and will soon relaunch under a new name (to be announced). Due to this, and after much consideration, we have decided to delist the game for now as we embark on this new journey.

We’re excited to continue crafting puzzle games that challenge and inspire, while also branching out into new genres and experiences. 

This is not goodbye—this is a transition to something bigger and better. Thank you for joining us. We can’t wait to share what’s next with you.

With gratitude and excitement,
Woodcrest Games
